sentences.text:
Applicant :- Nasreen Begum
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Madhavi,Vimal Dharm Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to allow the application and direct the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Prayagraj to decide the Complaint Case No.
1165 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. as expeditiously as possible within stipulated period.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that applicant has filed the aforesaid case in the year 2022 but the trail court has not decided the case till date.

4. Considering the fact that the trial has remained pending since 2022, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
